title: Wish you were here
logline: Wednesday. A postcard to Gully from sixty-one miles away. 'Wish you were here. It's far.' Gully pins it to the corkboard next to the 2003 rough and writes '61 mi' on it in marker.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY reading a postcard at the counter. BARNABY under the end stool — the dog came home Tuesday; the travelogue didn't.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man in an apron reading a postcard at his counter while an old dog lies beneath the end stool
image.notes: The dog is home; Wood is 'away' at Coos Bay. The strip lets the dog opt out of the bit.

panels.composition: The postcard: COOS BAY, a photo of a bridge. The back, in Wood's hand: 'Wish you were here. It's far. —W.'

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a postcard showing a bridge with a short handwritten message on its back
image.notes: Letter after: 'Wish you were here. It's far. —W.'

panels.composition: Gully with a marker. Writing on the postcard's front, over the bridge: 61 MI.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man in an apron writing a distance in marker across the front of a postcard

panels.composition: The card pinned beside the 2003 rough. The dog looking up at it. Gully to the dog.

balloons.text: He'll be back Friday. He's got a shift.
...It's sixty-one miles, Barnaby. I've driven farther for bait.
